bundle.shortDescription: A modern, lightweight Minecraft launcher built with Tauri and Rust.
bundle.longDescription: Elytra Launcher provides game version downloads, ModLoader installation, account management, LAN play, and content management for Minecraft on Windows, macOS, and Linux.
